_note: TCI model inputs. Proposed-system lambdas: per-link marginal integrities, anchored to, derived from or benchmarked against measurement. Baseline (paper, tablet) lambdas and timing inputs are author-specified assumptions, not measurements; they set the independence bound (product of lambdas) and dependence bound (min lambda) of each baseline scenario. Proposed-system timing is based on the measured session and reporting times (on-floor mean 847.4 s = 884.5 s full session minus 37.1 s reporting; record completion 37.1 s, SD 5.9). 'range' is the plausible 95% range used for the probabilistic sensitivity analysis (PSA); 'target_session_sd' is the session-level TCI SD to which the common dispersion coefficient of each condition is calibrated.

proposed.label: Proposed BIM-MR
proposed._range_basis: L1 and L4: the sweep ranges of Section 4.3.3 (not instrumented). L2: post-disambiguation accuracy 95% CI 93.5-95.8% (summary before the selection counts were rebuilt, as for lambda L2) divided by the L1 range. L3, L6: completeness CI 88.5-92.8% shared between L3, L6, L7. L5, L7: identifier correctness 100% on a finite set.

no_module_scoping.label: - module scoping
no_module_scoping._basis: Assumed: scoping off widens the candidate set (L2) and the context is no longer module-scoped (L4).

no_disambiguation.label: - n-best disambiguation
no_disambiguation._basis: lambda(L1) x lambda(L2) reproduces the measured top-1 accuracy: lambda(L2) = 0.840 / 0.972.

no_structured_schema.label: - structured evidence schema
no_structured_schema._basis: Assumed: free-text notes and unbound screenshots, so evidence binding and record addressability fall.

no_llm_context.label: - scene-conditioned LLM context
no_llm_context._basis: Assumed: generic prompt, so injection of the element and consistency of the narrative fail most of the time.
